name: Kylayne Priera
original_name: カイレイン・プリエーラ
source:
Character Design - Akisoba (秋蕎麦)

The 17th Princess (and the youngest) of the Reysol Kingdom. She is a fighter who, once she's decided on something, plunges straight ahead. Her skill with the sword surpasses [url=/c16748]Leo[/url]'s. She loves hot springs and can't stand the cold.


[Taken from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Valkyrie_Complex]Wikipedia[/url].]
